translation: Raw it is slightly cold, cooked it is warm, toxic. It governs dispersing phlegm-heat, fullness, and bindings of the heart, abdomen, chest, and diaphragm (心腹胸中膈痰熱滿結), cough and upward counterflow (咳嗽上氣), urgent pain and hard hardness below the heart (心下急痛堅痞), seasonal-qi vomiting (時氣嘔), disperses carbuncle swelling (消癰腫), causes abortion (胎墮), treats atrophic-yellow [disease] (痿黃), and  (rùn) the face (澤面目). Raw it makes one vomit; cooked it...
